g.text: Round85: D6 comparison at a common 3600-second cap
Markers are audited checkpoints; dashed lines only guide the eye. Missing U leaves U/gap blank; L is recorded.
Whole time includes startup, every native call and exit. An outlined square marks a valid hard-stop endpoint if present.
D6: V30/M3/Q30, mathematical T18000; exposed protection/repetition. U/L axes use their observed range.
